class.name: DQLayout
class.description: This class is used only by the DQM Display and defines how to display DQ Node objects in a graphical view.

attribute.name: Type
attribute.description: Layput type: Grid lays out shildren in rectangular grid, while Circular places them into circle segments

attribute.name: Rows
attribute.description: Number of rows for Grid or nested rings for Circle layout

attribute.name: Columns
attribute.description: Number of columns for Grid or ring sectors for Circle layout

attribute.name: Orientation
attribute.description: Defines how this layout will spread its children: horizontally row by row or vertically column by column

attribute.name: HSpacing
attribute.description: Gaps between subsequent columns in the layout given as fraction of a cell size.

attribute.name: VSpacing
attribute.description: Gaps between subsequent rows in the layout given as fraction of a cell size.

attribute.name: RowSpacing
attribute.description: Space-separated sequence of "n:s" tokens, where "n" is row number and "s" is spacing after it. The value is a fraction of a cell width.

attribute.name: ColumnSpacing
attribute.description: Space-separated sequence of "n:s" tokens, where "n" is column number and "s" is spacing after it. The value is a fraction of a cell height.

attribute.name: RowShifts
attribute.description: Space-separated sequence of "n:s" tokens, where "n" is row number and "s" is how much this row is shifted to the right with respect to the first column position. The value is a fraction of the a width.

attribute.name: ColumnShifts
attribute.description: Space-separated sequence of "n:s" tokens, where "n" is column number and "s" is how much this column is shifted down with respect to the first row position. The value is a fraction of the a height.

attribute.name: HMargins
attribute.description: Horizontal (left and right) margins of the layout given as fraction of a cell size

attribute.name: VMargins
attribute.description: Vertical (top and bottom) margins of the layout given as fraction of a cell size

attribute.name: ChildrenGrid
attribute.description: This pattern shows how children will use available cells. For example '(11000){5}(00011)' pattern means that first 2 children will take the first two cells in the grid, then the following 3 cells will be empty. This pattern repeats 5 times and then it is followed by 3 empty cells and 2 filled ones. Finally the whole patterns repeats until children are exhausted.

attribute.name: ChildrenSpan
attribute.description: This pattern is used to span children across multiple cells. It is a space separated sequence of the 'n:columns_to_span"x"rows_to_span' tokens. For example '5:3x2 11:1x7' pattern means that the 5th child will span across 3 columns and 2 rows and 11th one will span across 7 rows.

attribute.name: RowHeaders
attribute.description: Names of rows in the layout. Each row header has to be given in the following format "[row number:[rows to span:]]header text"

attribute.name: ColumnHeaders
attribute.description: Names of columns in the layout. Each columns header has to be given in the following format "[column number:[columns to span:]]header text"

attribute.name: Rotation
attribute.description: Clockwise rotation angle, in degrees, around the Z axis. Supported for Circular layouts only.

attribute.name: Labels
attribute.description: Text labels which will be placed into this layout. Each label has to be given in the following format "column row [columns_to_span"x"rows_to_span]:text"

relationship.name: DefaultChildrenShape
relationship.description: Default shape to be used for drawing children which do not define their shapes explicitly

class.name: DQTemplateParameter
class.description: Describes template for a number of DQParameters which will be instantiated at run time.

attribute.name: IDPattern
attribute.description: This string will be used as template for the ID's of the generated DQ Parameters

attribute.name: Instances
attribute.description: The lenght of this list defines a number of instances of DQParameter class which will be produced from this template at the database load time. Each item in the list must contain a comma separated list of 'key=value' pairs. IDs for the generated DQParameter instances will be produced by substituting {key} tokens in this object ID to the corresponding 'value' tokens from the list. In addition the same operation will be done for the InputDataSource attribute of this object.

attribute.name: DisabledInstances
attribute.description: This attribute contains a list of strings, which define individual parameters which will be set to disabled state during template instantiation. Each string in this list contains comma-separated sequnce of key=value pairs. During template instantiation each new instance whose set of key=value pairs contains that sequence will be immediatly disabled.

method-implementation.prototype: const std::vector<const DQParameter *> & get_instances(const std::string & tokens) const
const DQParameter * newInstance(const std::string & tokens) const
